title: First brew back.
note: A torn photo collage of a holiday that, small on a phone or blurred by a scroll, turns into the first cup of tea back home.
process: Code only, no generative model. The photos are 39 CC0 and public domain pictures from Wikimedia Commons (via the card-photos collection on GitHub): sea, sunsets, clouds, lakes, mountains, sunflowers, lavender. [[Claude Code]] wrote a [[Python]] script with [[NumPy]] that tears them, picks and crops each piece to match the same patch of one photo, a glass of tea, then swaps in that photo's low frequencies, so up close you see the holiday and at a glance you see the brew. The type is [[Google Fonts]] Courier Prime.
keywords: travelling back home from a holiday
